name: AI Training
heroSubtitle: Practical artificial intelligence training designed to help individuals and businesses understand AI and use it more effectively.
shortDescription: We provide practical AI training that helps individuals and teams understand AI tools, improve productivity and explore new possibilities.
fullDescription: TOP TECH provides practical artificial intelligence training for individuals, entrepreneurs, professionals and businesses. We help learners understand AI concepts and explore how modern AI tools can support everyday tasks, content creation, research, business operations and problem-solving. Our training focuses on practical demonstrations, responsible use and real-world applications, helping participants build confidence and develop useful digital skills.

benefits.title: Immediate Everyday Productivity
benefits.description: Participants leave with repeatable prompt patterns and tool setups they can apply to real tasks the same day.

benefits.title: Role-Specific Relevance
benefits.description: Exercises are tailored to your industry—whether operations, marketing, education, administration, or software.

benefits.title: Safe, Verification-First Habits
benefits.description: Learn practical guidelines for fact-checking AI outputs, protecting sensitive data, and maintaining quality standards.

features.title: Structured Prompt Frameworks
features.description: Master context framing, role assignment, constraints, structured output formats, and iterative refinement.

features.title: Tool Ecosystem Walkthroughs
features.description: Hands-on practice with modern text, research, spreadsheet, coding, and visual AI assistants.

features.title: Business Workflow Labs
features.description: Drafting SOPs, summarizing reports, organizing meeting notes, and accelerating customer communications.

features.title: Custom Team Playbooks
features.description: Take-home prompt libraries and checklists documented specifically for your organization.

processSteps.title: Skill & Workflow Assessment
processSteps.description: We identify your team's current familiarity with AI and the daily tasks with highest time-saving potential.

processSteps.title: Custom Curriculum Design
processSteps.description: We assemble focused exercises, prompt templates, and tool workflows matching your roles.

processSteps.title: Interactive Hands-On Sessions
processSteps.description: Live guided workshops (remote or on-site) where every participant practices directly.

processSteps.title: Playbook Delivery & Follow-Up
processSteps.description: Participants receive reference guides, prompt libraries, and post-session Q&A support.

faqs.question: Do participants need a technical or coding background?
faqs.answer: No. Our core practical AI and prompt engineering tracks are designed for non-technical professionals, founders, students, and teams, with optional technical tracks for developers.

faqs.question: Can training be customized for our company department?
faqs.answer: Yes. We tailor examples and lab exercises directly around your team's real documents, workflows, and daily tasks.

faqs.question: Are sessions available online as well as in person?
faqs.answer: Yes. We deliver live interactive online workshops globally as well as on-site team sessions by arrangement.

idealFor: Individuals, professionals, educators, and corporate teams adopting AI for everyday productivity.
